title: No Fair Play
description:
An anti-game :No Fair Play is a game that allows you to beat your opponents by any means necessary. Is a member of the opposing team a good dribbler? Aim for their legs! Punch, tackle, grab... it's up to you to choose how you gain the upper hand over your opponent.
Multiplayer and Bots :Start a game with bots, finish with real players. You can allow other players to join your game and take the place of a bot. If someone leaves the game or disconnects, a bot will immediately takes his place.Based on physics :Ragdolls, ball control, player interactions... physics gives players more opportunities to have fun with unexpected situations.
Intuitive gameplay :Simple controls and rules, the ball goes where you aim, the shooting angle is automatically calculated. But simple gameplay doesn't mean limited gameplay. There are several advanced mechanics that require skill.
Parkour gameplay :Parkour maps and a parkour game mode for those who want something more challenging.
Customisable character :Choose your cut, your clothes, your colors and join the field.
First Person View :You can play in first person view with a VR headset or not.
Note : A gamepad with 2 sticks is required.
description_short: No Fair Play is a physics-based multiplayer game that combines parkour, combat, and football mechanics to offer great freedom to players.
